title: 지정재판부의 구성과 운영에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:5:0:00005:part:1/1
full_text: Article 5 (Acting for Justices) Where a Justice of a Panel is temporarily absent from office or unable to perform duties, the Justice in the same column in Panel No. 2 shall act for a Justice of Panel No. 1, the Justice in the same column in Panel No. 3 shall act for a Justice of Panel No. 2, and the Justice in the same column in Panel No. 1 shall act for a Justice of Panel No. 3: Provided, That where the Justice in the same column is unable to act, the Justice in the immediately following column shall act; in the case of a Justice in Column Da, the Justice in Column Ga shall act.
